clips.label: 不死虎妖冷开
clips.scene: 夕照尸场，贯胸虎妖在画右上高位睁眼起身，姜月初中景僵住，裴长青低位失血。

shots.description: 黑妖血从贯胸空洞滴落，虎眼突然睁开。
姜月初瞳孔收紧，乱发被风掀起。
三者纵深关系与封死出口。

subtitle_lines: 别跑了……这荒郊野岭的，你们想去哪儿？
它胸口明明被捅穿了——为什么还能站起来？！

# 《万妖图魔录》第1集｜素材清单
## 共享资产
- `CHAR_01/囚犯常态`：姜月初，年轻东方女性，鹅蛋脸、长杏眼、长黑发凌乱披散，高挑纤细，灰褐粗布囚服，尘土冷汗，无血点常态。
  - EN: Young East Asian woman, small oval face, long almond eyes, long disheveled black hair, tall slender build, dusty gray-brown rough prison robe, restrained alert expression, no blood spots in the base form.
- `CHAR_02/重伤镇魔卫`：裴长青，二十出头东方男性，军伍体格，玄黑暗赤云纹劲装，失血惨白，左臂扭曲，胸腹战伤。
  - EN: Young East Asian male demon guard, military build, black fitted uniform with dark red cloud insignia, severe blood loss, twisted left arm, multiple battle wounds.
- `BEAST_01/实体_重伤复活`：虎头人身、黑黄粗硬毛、山岳般雄壮，胸口巨大贯穿窟窿和黑妖血始终保留。
  - EN: Massive tiger-headed humanoid demon, coarse black-and-ochre fur, powerful humanlike torso, persistent gaping chest wound with black demonic blood, never healed.
- `LOC_01/夕照荒野尸场`：陇右风沙、冷灰土褐、低位夕阳左后逆光、巨岩在画右上、南向出口在画左深处、尸骸与枯草分布稳定。
  - EN: Desolate Longyou corpse field at sunset, cold gray and earth brown palette, low warm backlight from rear left, large boulder upper right, southern escape path deep left, stable corpses and dry grass layout.
- `PROP_01/断刀`：暗色旧钢军用直刃，半截、沾血、无华丽纹饰；持有与落点按 possession ledger。
  - EN: Broken military straight blade in dark weathered steel, blood-stained, utilitarian, no ornate fantasy decoration.
- `PROP_02/镇魔司横刀`：同僚尸旁遗落的完整军用横刀，暗色旧钢、长直刃、无华饰；裴于 Clip 10 捡起，Clip 11 落在姜脚边，Clip 16 起由姜持有。
  - EN: Complete military hengdao found beside a fallen demon guard, long straight dark-steel blade, utilitarian and unornamented; picked up by Pei in Clip 10, dropped beside Jiang in Clip 11, held by Jiang from Clip 16 onward.
- `VFX_01/百妖谱底框`：黑金古卷、金墨符纹边框、内部大面积干净空白；文字数字全部后期 overlay。
  - EN: Black-and-gold ancient scroll interface with restrained golden ink sigils and a large clean empty center, no readable text or numbers, overlay-ready.
- 风格锚：暗黑盛唐写实国漫、真实3D材质、9:16电影光位，黑金奇观只在百妖谱域出现。
